newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures surge, all months rise by limit.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures surge, all months rise by limit.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures surged on Friday, with all months up by the daily limit of 500 yen by the close as the Chicago market's price rallies overnight triggered active buying from individual investors, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended up 500 yen at 16,000 yen per tonne. The spread between the spot and the distant month was 1,790 yen at the close.

All contracts continued to gain from the opening, due to fresh buying from local investors, traders said. Stronger corn prices on CBOT Project A overnight trading accelerated buying in the afternoon, they said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.07-1/2 per bushel at 0745 GMT, against $3.06-1/4 at Thursday's close.
The CBOT soybean futures spot March contract was at $8.18 at 0745 GMT, unchanged from Thursday's close.
